_comment: CANONICAL faithful page layouts — the single source of truth for the student CRM view, student workbook, and teacher flipbook. Each page is an ordered list of regions; text regions hold VERIFIED transcriptions checked against the official workbook. Picture cells use source-faithful crops: the identical teacher-color drawing when the flip chart contains it, otherwise the exact original student-workbook drawing. Never generate, redraw, or guess colors. A page absent here uses its existing fallback.
_status: Pages 1-22 (introduction, vowels, Lesson 7) and pages 23-90 (Lessons 8-24) have structured native layouts. Pages 1-22 were re-checked verbatim against the book scans on 2026-09-30 (printed instruction wording, picture identity, answer keys); src/data/book-transcription/lessons-01-07.json is the reference and src/lib/__tests__/book-fidelity-lessons-01-07.test.ts guards it. Lessons 8-24 were re-transcribed verbatim from the book scans on 2026-09-30 (write -> circle -> letter -> complete order, book instruction wording, no added pictures); src/data/book-transcription/lessons-08-24.json is the reference and src/lib/__tests__/book-fidelity-lessons-08-24.test.ts guards it. Exceptions: page 86 fill-in items are pending the Rescan PDF; page 87 follows the fixed writing-page pattern but is not yet scan-verified.
